senses.gloss: (b. h.) to nip; to prune; to cut.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 73b:4">Sabb. 73ᵇ</cite> <he>זוֹמֵר וצריך וכ׳</he> if one trims a tree (on the Sabbath) for making use of the wood.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 26a:10">Snh. 26ᵃ</cite> <he>כהן וזומר</he> (not <he>וזמר</he>) a priest is he, and he prunes the vine (in the sabbatical year)!; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to be pruned, trnsf. to be checked, unnerved, defeated.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:12:1">Cant. R. to II, 12</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="G00521"><he>זמיר</he></cite> <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:12:1">ib.</cite>) <he>הגיע זמנה של ערלה שתִּזָּמֵר</he> the time for pruning the preputium (circumcision) has come (v.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 19">Ex. R. s. 19</cite>); <he>הגיע … שיִזָּמֵרוּ</he> the time has come for the Egyptians to be checked; Pesik. Haḥod., p. 50ᵃ; <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 15:1">Pesik. R. s. 15</cite>.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 9">Lev. R. s. 9</cite>, beg. Akhan is named Zimri (<cite ref="I Chronicles 2:6">I Chr. II, 6</cite>, cmp. with <cite ref="Joshua 7:24">Josh. VII, 24</cite>) <he>שנִזְמְרוּ … על ידו</he> because through him the Israelites were unnerved (<cite ref="Joshua 7:5">Josh. VII, 5</cite>); a. e.
